last updated：May 18, 2020 
 インターケミ 
 Official site 
Albin Corporation is the world's leading manufacturer of battery charging and discharging equipment. 
Arbin Corporation was founded in 1991 in Texas, USA, and is an integrated company engaged in the research, development, production, and testing of energy storage devices (batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells) and testing equipment. The Arbin charge/discharge testing equipment features industry-leading 24-bit resolution. It can detect overvoltage, overcurrent, and overheating of the test subjects. It also includes robust safety features for lithium-ion battery testing. With voltage differential characteristics (dQ(V)/dV) and high-precision coulometry (HPC), it is ideal for battery lifecycle testing. The diffusion coefficient for each composition of the battery can also be measured.
Collaboration with Arbin and other companies' temperature and humidity chambers allows for automated charge/discharge testing under controlled temperature and humidity conditions.
In collaboration with impedance measurement devices such as Autolab's PG204/FRA32M, all channels of the Arbin charge/discharge equipment can sequentially perform electrochemical impedance measurements.

basic information 
Arbin, founded in 1991 in Texas, USA, is a company that specializes in the research, development, production, and integration of energy storage devices (batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells), testing equipment, and testing technologies. Arbin is a leading manufacturer of battery charge and discharge equipment in the world. Interchem Co., Ltd. is the sole agent for Arbin in Japan, providing reliable and trustworthy support. Arbin's major clients include Tesla and Ford Motor Company.

Applications/Examples of results 
Arbin, a company in the United States, has developed nine series of research equipment tailored for various research fields such as battery materials, secondary batteries, supercapacitors, electric vehicles, flow batteries, and fuel cells, according to the intended use in terms of voltage range, current range, and voltage-current pulse width. 
Detailed information 
Basic Specifications
· Control Voltage: (-5) to 5V 
· Current: Maximum 5A 
· Current Range: 5A/500mA/20mA/1mA
· Number of Channels: 4 to 64 channels (completely independent, channel selection)
The Arbin MSTAT series is a multi-channel potentiostat/galvanostat designed for battery testing and materials research. It is a reliable high-precision charge and discharge measurement system for researchers. Each channel is an independent potentiostat/galvanostat, fully controlling test profiles and data logging, providing unparalleled flexibility. The Arbin MSTAT offers true bipolar circuitry, ensuring cross-zero linearity without switching time between charging and discharging. MSTAT provides both digital and analog voltage control. Digital control maximizes the safety of battery cycling and can handle dynamic device resistance. On the other hand, analog control addresses the high-speed response and stability required for electrochemical applications. It is an economical model that supports high-precision measurements and fast data sampling. All models are supported by Arbin MITS measurement and Data Watcher data analysis software. 
Measurement data using the Arbin charge and discharge device MSTAT4 
Main applications: 
Lifecycle testing of 2nd generation batteries (lithium-ion batteries) 
dQ/dV and Coulomb efficiency (HPC) measurements 
Constant current step (GITT) method & constant voltage step (PITT) method 
Testing of symmetric cells 
Cyclic and linear sweep voltammetry 
Chronoamperometry 
Chronoamperometry 
Chronopotentiometry 
Multi-electrode testing 
EIS (Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy) 
Half-cell testing and material research

You can choose from three types of models: Arbin LBT Cell, MSTAT, and HSP testers, and combine them with the Autolab PGSTAT204 & FRA32M potentiostat/galvanostat to perform electrochemical impedance measurements across each channel (32 channels) in a sequential measurement frequency range (10 μHz to 1 MHz). 
Features: 
- EIS measurement frequency range (10 μHz to 1 MHz) 
- Autolab impedance measurement data is integrated with Arbin charge/discharge measurement data 
- Fully maximized duty cycle 
- No changes to connections are required 
- Applicable to the Arbin LBT Cell, MSTAT, and HSP testers series 
- Each Autolab EIS unit can be multiplexed to a maximum of 32 Arbin channels 
Arbin's LBT series supports long-term lifecycle, EV drive profiles, battery pulse charging, and various custom charging/discharging methods. All models are supported by Arbin MITS measurement and Data Watcher data analysis software. 
Basic Specifications 
· Maximum cell voltage of 10V 
· Maximum cell current of 2500A 
· Ability to test up to 96 cells in a single chassis 
Main Applications 
· Measurement of electrochemistry, batteries, and supercapacitors 
· Coulombic efficiency (HPCE) measurement 
· Testing of electric vehicle (EV) cells 
· Lifecycle testing/repeated load endurance testing 
· EIS electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (10 μHz to 1 MHz) (in combination with Autolab PGSTAT204 & FRA32M) 
· Measurement resolution: 24 bits (16,777,216 in 1 part) 
· Measurement accuracy: <25ppm or <100ppm 
· Control accuracy: <0.01% or <0.02% 
· Minimum step time: 5ms 
· Data logging rate: 2000 points per second 
· Ventilation method: air-cooled with variable speed fan
